note: Forever-free means no registration fee. You do not get a leftover .com. Freenom (.tk/.cf/.gq/.ga/.ml free regs) ended in 2024. Year-1 cheap TLDs are not $0 forever.

programs.name: EU.org
programs.who: Anyone; aimed at people and nonprofits who cannot pay a NIC
programs.how: Request at nic.eu.org. Approval often takes about two weeks. Not the European Union.

programs.name: is-a.dev
programs.how: Open a pull request on the is-a-dev/register repo. Check the box on this page first.

programs.name: thedev.id
programs.who: Developers who want a personal identity hostname
programs.how: Fork thedev.id, add a CNAME file for your slug, open a pull request.

programs.name: is-a-good.dev
programs.how: Register via their site / GitHub flow. Confirm the register repo is live before you wait on a PR.

programs.name: js.org
programs.who: JavaScript projects only — they turned down personal blogs
programs.how: Pull request on js-org/js.org. Need a real JS project.

programs.name: GitHub Pages
programs.who: Anyone with a free GitHub account
programs.how: Create a repo named youruser.github.io. That is this site's host.

programs.name: Cloudflare Pages
programs.how: Deploy a Pages project. You get project.pages.dev. Not a TLD you own.

programs.name: Netlify
programs.who: Anyone; bandwidth limits on free tier
programs.how: Deploy a site, pick a subdomain in the Netlify UI.

programs.name: FreeDNS (afraid.org)
programs.who: Anyone; public shared domains get a random-looking host
programs.how: Sign up at freedns.afraid.org and claim a subdomain on a shared domain.

programs.name: DuckDNS
programs.who: Anyone who needs a stable hostname for a changing IP
programs.how: Log in with GitHub/Google and claim you.duckdns.org. Dynamic DNS, not a personal brand.

programs.name: ClouDNS free zone
programs.who: Anyone who wants a hostname plus DNS records
programs.how: Create a free account, add a Free Zone, pick a hostname on their shared suffixes.

programs.name: pp.ua
programs.who: Anyone who can complete their form
programs.how: Request a subdomain at the pp.ua registry pages. Confirm current signup before you wait.

programs.name: Open Domains
programs.cost: Listed as $0 — verify the live register repo
programs.who: Personal sites and open-source projects, if the original project is still the one answering
programs.how: js.org still points here. open-domains.net redirected to a different site in Aug 2026. Do not file a PR until you confirm the GitHub register repo.

programs.name: Freenom (.tk .cf .gq .ga .ml)
programs.who: Nobody — free regs ended 2024 after Meta sued. 2026: paid again, not $0.
programs.how: Do not chase leftover Freenom names. They are not a free pile.
